Tosa Full Moon Bicycle Ride

Wauwatosa, WI · Social · Cruiser

Tosa Full Moon Bicycle Ride is a social and cruiser group ride in Wauwatosa, WI. Schedule: Every full moon evening, from Metro Wauwatosa (start posted each month).

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 10–12 mph: you can talk the whole way. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @milwaukeebikerides the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Tosa Full Moon Bicycle Ride group ride

A slow 10-to-12-mile night ride around Wauwatosa on each full moon. Any bike. Start point and time are posted before each ride on the Milwaukee Bike Rides Instagram.
